title: Only One Defender
setup: Your knight attacks the bishop on e5, and it stands there only because the knight on c6 guards it.
hint: The bishop you are attacking has exactly one defender. Ask what that defender costs, not what it holds.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxc6}} takes the only piece guarding e5. After {{bxc6}} the bishop hangs and {{Nxe5}} collects it; if Black rescues the bishop instead, the knight is simply gone. Count the defenders of a target before you count the attackers.
